name: vinted-scraper
title: Vinted Scraper: Search Results from 9 Countries
description: Get Vinted listings from search and catalog pages: title, brand, size, condition, price with and without buyer fee, favourites, photos and seller link. Works for Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Poland, Belgium, Austria and the UK.
readme:
# Vinted Scraper

Get listings from Vinted search and catalog pages in nine countries. For each item you get the title, brand, size, condition, price, the buyer protection fee and total price, favourite count, photos and a link to the public seller profile. No login is needed.

Supported sites: Germany (vinted.de), France (vinted.fr), the Netherlands (vinted.nl), Italy (vinted.it), Spain (vinted.es), Poland (vinted.pl), Belgium (vinted.be), Austria (vinted.at) and the United Kingdom (vinted.co.uk).

## What you can do with it

- Track prices for a brand or a product in one or more countries.
- Compare the same search across countries.
- Find the newest listings for a search, sorted newest first.
- Build a price history for resale research.
- Collect seller links for items in a category.

## Pricing

You pay per delivered item plus one small start fee per run. Items that are not delivered are not charged.

| Event | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Item scraped (`vinted-item-result`) | $0.0012 per item ($1.20 per 1,000) |

The start fee is charged once, together with the first delivered batch. A run that delivers nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost for the run, the actor stops cleanly when the limit is reached and says so in the run status.

## Input

| Field | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `searchQueries` | Words to search for, for example `nike`. |
| `country` | Which Vinted site to search: `de`, `fr`, `nl`, `it`, `es`, `pl`, `be`, `at` or `co.uk`. Default `de`. |
| `startUrls` | Vinted catalog or search addresses to read instead of, or as well as, the queries. Filters in the address are kept, and a `page` number sets the first page. The country is taken from the address. |
| `order` | `relevance`, `newest_first`, `price_low_to_high` or `price_high_to_low`. |
| `priceFrom`, `priceTo` | Price range in the currency of the country. |
| `brandIds`, `sizeIds`, `statusIds`, `catalogIds` | Vinted filter numbers, as they appear in the address of a Vinted search (`brand_ids[]`, `size_ids[]`, `status_ids[]`, `catalog[]`). Condition numbers: 6 new with tags, 1 new without tags, 2 very good, 3 good, 4 satisfactory. |
| `maxResults` | Most items for the whole run. Default 50. |
| Connection settings | Leave the default. The actor picks the connection it needs and uses one from the country you selected. |

Example: the first 100 results for a search in Germany.

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["nike"],
  "country": "de",
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

Example: newest listings under 30 euros in France, from a catalog address.

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://www.vinted.fr/catalog?search_text=levi%27s%20501"],
  "order": "newest_first",
  "priceTo": 30,
  "maxResults": 200
}
```

## Output sample

```json
{
  "id": 10673273630,
  "url": "https://www.vinted.de/items/10673273630-nike-sport-top",
  "title": "Nike Sport Top",
  "brand": "Nike",
  "size": "M",
  "condition": "Sehr gut",
  "price": 5,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "price_with_discount": null,
  "buyer_protection_fee": 0.95,
  "total_price": 5.95,
  "favourite_count": 12,
  "photos": ["https://images1.vinted.net/t/05_001e6_.../f800/474a3363.webp"],
  "main_photo": "https://images1.vinted.net/t/05_001e6_.../f800/474a3363.webp",
  "seller_id": 47417943,
  "seller_profile_url": "https://www.vinted.de/member/47417943",
  "seller_is_business": false,
  "is_promoted": false,
  "country": "DE",
  "domain": "vinted.de",
  "position": 97,
  "page": 2,
  "search_query": "nike",
  "source_url": "https://www.vinted.de/catalog?search_text=nike&page=2",
  "scraped_at": "2026-11-05T12:00:00Z"
}
```

Other fields: `thumbnail_url`, `dominant_color`, `seller_photo_url`, `search_score` and `catalog_id`. Fields that Vinted does not show for an item are `null`.

## Limitations

- The data comes from the search result cards. Description text, upload date, view count, seller login name and seller ratings are not on those cards, so they are not included.
- The size and condition texts are in the language of the Vinted site you search.
- Vinted shows about 960 items for one search (10 pages of 96). Use several queries, filters or price ranges to get more.
- The category ID is only filled when the search is limited to one category.
- A listing can sell or change price between two pages of one run, so a few items may be missing or repeated across pages.
- Prices are per country. The actor does not convert currencies.
- Vinted can change its pages at any time, which can interrupt the data until the actor is updated.
- Searches in the US are not supported because Vinted does not operate there.

## FAQ

**Do I need a Vinted account?** No. The actor reads public search pages only.

**Which country is used?** The `country` field, or the country of each address in `startUrls`. A run can mix addresses from different countries.

**Why is `total_price` higher than `price`?** Vinted adds a buyer protection fee at checkout. The actor reports it as `buyer_protection_fee` and adds it up in `total_price`.

**What does `is_promoted` mean?** The seller paid for the item to be shown higher in the list.

**Can I run it on a schedule?** Yes. Use `order` set to `newest_first` and a small `maxResults` to pick up new listings.

**What if I get no results?** Check the search in a browser on the same Vinted site. A search with no matches returns zero items, and the run status says so.
